events.name: Sail Boston 2026 — the tall ships return
events.meta: Free · 50+ tall ships from 21 countries for the country's 250th. Parade of Sail Sat 9am-4pm (inner harbor ~10:15am, USS Constitution leads with a jet flyover; watch from Castle Island, the Seaport, East Boston, or Charlestown). Free ship boarding Sat 5-10pm, then Sun-Wed 10am-10pm. Harbor fireworks Sat AND Wed 9:15pm. Crew parade Mon noon-3. Huge crowds: take the T, go early. source
